# Kyphrus
The primary star of the Colossus sector. A stable A-class star with a populated habitable zone.
This star was, like many others, identified long ago, eventually being prospected by one of millions of Confederate probes as a potential area for colonization. Eventually, information got back to the fringe of the Perseus arm, prompting a few colonization fleets. Due to the distance compared to other, more local prospects, not many made the journey to Kyphrus in the beginning. Nobody was aware of the Colossus Radius at the time. The system has five notable astronomical bodies: [color=green]Asclepiu[/color], [color=yellow]Merak[/color], [color=orange]Fervidus[/color], [color=cyan]Thrascias[/color] and [color=red]Aerumna[/color]. The former two are hospitable, while the rest are determined too inhospitable for different reasons.
Around the star itself is a ring of communications-interfering debris that prevents anyone from staying in highly close orbit for long, as it would cause total systems failure within days without proper shielding. It is also theorized to be connected to the emissions around the Colossus Radius, though this is largely debunked.
